label: vcr-matching criteria-parse check set
note: Authored, realistic eligibility texts in the style of ClinicalTrials.gov and ChiCTR registrations, with the structure a careful reader would give each line (an exclusion is written as the registry states it, the condition that excludes). Not records taken from the registries, and written and labelled by one author: this checks the comparator and keeps the examples stable. It does not measure how well a model parses.

cases.text:
Patients must meet all of the following criteria.
Inclusion Criteria:
* Age >= 18 years
* Histologically or cytologically confirmed stage IIIB or IV non-small cell lung cancer
* Documented EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R mutation
* Disease progression on or after a first-line EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor
* ECOG performance status of 0 or 1

Exclusion Criteria:
* Symptomatic or untreated brain metastases
* Prior treatment with docetaxel for advanced disease

expected.sourceText: Histologically or cytologically confirmed stage IIIB or IV non-small cell lung cancer
Documented EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R mutation
Disease progression on or after a first-line EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor
Prior treatment with docetaxel for advanced disease

cases.text:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 18 to 75 years
* Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus for at least 6 months
* HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.5% at screening
* Stable dose of metformin of at least 1500 mg/day for 12 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:
* Type 1 diabetes mellitus
* History of diabetic ketoacidosis
* Estimated glomerular filtration rate below 45 mL/min/1.73 m2

Stable dose of metformin of at least 1500 mg/day for 12 weeks
